title: Address ACP description placement feedback, guard coverage and refusal helper maintenance
outcome: Address ACP description placement feedback, guard coverage and refusal helper maintenance
acceptance: Decide and document actionable feedback for ACP descriptions rejected only by placement while preserving no-late-check, authority and admission guards; add a pinning regression for the chosen behavior.
Add meaningful description-path controls for disabled/stale context, Build, one-call and placement cases without weakened assertions or enlarged timeouts.
Update described-path documentation and reduce nested snapshot complexity/module size through a cohesive helper or struct; focused regressions and exact-input full gate pass before completion.
